summary: First Guaranty Bancshares, Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing that its subsidiary, First Guaranty Bank, entered a Stipulation to the Issuance of a Consent Order with the FDIC and Louisiana OFI, effective August 7, 2026. The Consent Order stems from a September 2, 2025 joint examination and requires the Bank to maintain Tier 1 leverage capital of at least 9% and total risk-based capital of at least 14%, restrict certain credit extensions, and enhance board oversight. The Bank consented without admitting or denying charges. This is a regulatory enforcement action, not a special-situation transaction; thus, no deal terms or risk-arb angle apply. Watch for ongoing regulatory compliance and capital maintenance.
